CardReadData.name: Card Read Data
CardReadData.definition: Card reading capabilities of the ATM performing the transaction.

CardWriteData.name: Card Write Data
CardWriteData.definition: Card writing capabilities of the terminal performing the transaction.

Authentication.name: Authentication
Authentication.definition: Customer and card authentication capabilities available at the ATM.

PINLengthCapabilities.name: PIN Length Capabilities
PINLengthCapabilities.definition: Maximum number of digits the ATM is able to accept when the cardholder enters its PIN.

ApprovalCodeLength.name: Approval Code Length
ApprovalCodeLength.definition: Maximum number of characters of the approval code the ATM is able to manage.

MaxScriptLength.name: Max Script Length
MaxScriptLength.definition: Maximum data length in bytes that a card issuer can return to the ICC at the terminal.

CardCaptureCapable.name: Card Capture Capable
CardCaptureCapable.definition: True if the ATM is able to capture card.|Usage: When absent, default value is True.

WithdrawalMedia.name: Withdrawal Media
WithdrawalMedia.definition: Type of media the ATM is able to dispense.

DepositedMedia.name: Deposited Media
DepositedMedia.definition: Type of media the customer is able to deposit in the ATM.

MessageCapabilities.name: Message Capabilities
MessageCapabilities.definition: Capabilities of the terminal to display       Interactive Transaction Capabilities such as DCC, Fees, Accounts, etc. which the terminal can support.or print message to the cardholder and the merchant.

InteractiveTransactions.name: Interactive Transactions
InteractiveTransactions.definition: Interactive Transaction Capabilities such as DCC, Fees, Accounts, etc. which the terminal can support.

ReceiptPrinting.name: Receipt Printing
ReceiptPrinting.definition: Whether the terminal can print a receipt (i.e. the device is functional, and it has paper).|Usage: When absent, default value is True.
